objective: Measure the installed Codex CLI and App Server protocols with one structured read-only repository assessment, cancellation probe, usage capture, and sanitized evidence.

businessImpact.hypothesis: Measured protocol evidence prevents an incompatible adapter choice and avoids rework before the orchestrator handles revenue-supporting engineering tasks.
businessImpact.metric: Phase 0 done criteria passed with zero repository writes from the read-only probes

summary: Validate TaskContract and ResultContract schemas and committed examples.
Capture installed Codex CLI and generated App Server protocol evidence.
Run structured read-only exec and App Server lifecycle probes.
Record a measured Phase 1 adapter recommendation.
nonGoals: No product runtime, API, database, migration, CI, deployment, or commerce change.
No durable ledger, router, worker, webhook, or production orchestrator implementation.
No new OAuth, secret, paid API, permission expansion, or external write.

reasons: The probes are read-only normal-risk discovery, but repository policy classifies the initial automation bootstrap as manual.

doneCriteria.description: Both contract schemas compile and their Phase 0 examples validate.
Installed CLI version and generated App Server schema bundle hash are recorded.
One structured codex exec assessment completes in read-only mode with thread, events, usage, and unchanged Git status.
App Server initialize, thread start/read/resume, turn start/completion, interrupt, and usage behavior are measured.
The Phase 1 adapter recommendation is based on measured complexity, recovery, and cancellation evidence.

commands.name: repository-quality
commands.command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

requiredEvidence: CLI and App Server schema version/hash

rollback.plan: Stop all probe processes, remove only Phase 0 documentation/evidence in this branch, and close the unmerged PR.
rollback.verification: Confirm no probe process remains, Git status matches the intended Phase 0 diff, and product/runtime paths are unchanged.
